scope: review-only default-off PostgreSQL immutable quote facts plus append-only activation/revocation transitions

contract.facts: shared_key_quote_versions stores immutable seller/key, four NUMERIC(18,6) prices, NUMERIC(8,6) commission, USD, per_million_tokens, shared_seller_key and entitlement version
contract.transitions: shared_key_quote_transitions appends activate or revoke, expected predecessor, seller snapshot and database-assigned per-key sequence/effective_at; a quote version activates at most once
contract.ownerTransfer: deferred owner guard requires a matching transition in the same transaction when a key with transition history changes seller_user_id
contract.dispatchSelector: claim_shared_key_quote_for_dispatch takes the key FOR SHARE in READ COMMITTED and refuses missing or revoked heads; a future producer must persist transition_id and quote_version_id in the same transaction
contract.asOf: sequence/version reference is authoritative for financial attempts; time lookup is retrospective audit only because effective_at precedes COMMIT visibility
contract.activation: reviewed-v2, direct migrator LOGIN, exact 73-version ledger under SHARE lock, runtime effective ACL denied
contract.deploymentPrerequisite: migrator must hold database CREATE to create the private schema; proposal does not grant it

negativeCoverage: ledger DML lock timeout, missing or forged formal migration, price precision drift, missing DB CREATE, non-LOGIN migrator, SET ROLE proxy and runtime role inheritance
all 12 required quote fields, four NUMERIC NaN inputs, invalid prices/rate/enums/seller, duplicate quote ID, multirow quote/transition writes
stale predecessor, client-supplied historical effective_at or sequence, invalid transition kind, duplicate quote activation and cross-key quote
unplanned reprice, revoke/reactivate and owner transfer preserve prior prices and seller; bare owner transfer rolls back
second operator waits on key and loses stale-predecessor race; uncommitted new event leaves old quote visible and captured reference unchanged after COMMIT
new billable claim waits on uncommitted revoke and is denied after revoke commits; prior active quote remains historically resolvable
matching and empty UPDATE/DELETE, TRUNCATE, parent delete and runtime effective ACL after two gateway grant reruns
previousEvidence: C04-postgres-shared-key-quote-versions-v337-results.json is a historical finite-interval contract and no longer matches the current proposal SQL
limits: The dispatch selector is review-only and currently callable only by the direct migrator LOGIN; no real request log transaction invokes it or persists a version reference.
A caller that releases the claim transaction before persisting its attempt can race a later transition; runtime producer integration remains open.
Time-as-of can retrospectively resolve a newly committed event whose effective_at was assigned before COMMIT; financial recomputation must use the captured version ID.
Current SharedKeyRow lacks entitlement version, billing mode, currency, price unit and immutable quote version ID.
D1/MySQL parity, typed outbox, earnings consumer, real Workers and production concurrency remain unverified; C04.1/G remain open.
